name: betainv
expr: x_uniform = betainv(ps, 1, 1); x_sym05 = betainv(ps, 0.5, 0.5); x_25 = betainv(ps, 2, 5); x_1010 = betainv(ps, 10, 10); x_p0 = betainv(0.0, 2, 3); x_p1 = betainv(1.0, 2, 3); x_pneg = betainv(-0.1, 2, 3); x_a0 = betainv(0.5, 0, 3);
comment: Sig: x = betainv(p, a, b). Inverse Beta CDF. Covers (a,b) ∈ {(1,1) uniform, (0.5,0.5) U-shaped, (2,5), (10,10)} × p ∈ {0.05, 0.5, 0.95}. Edges: p=0 => 0; p=1 => 1; p outside [0,1] => NaN; invalid shape => NaN.
